s.headline: Fortnitemares & Override: New Horrors, Sprites, FNAF Bosses
top_changes: New Fortnitemares Islands and Safety in Numbers Quest
Override mode with Sonic, Tetris, Pac-Man inspired areas
Cursed cartridge corrupts BR with new weapons and bosses
Five Nights at Freddy's animatronic bosses at Pizza Parlor
New collectible Sprites with powers; Ranked with abilities off
s.meta_impact: New bosses and mechanics from FNAF and cursed cartridge add horror elements to Battle Royale fights. Sprites introduce collectible powers outside Ranked, shifting strategy toward extraction and leveling. Overrides and themed areas expand exploration and rule-breaking gameplay.

breakdown.change: Spreads corruption in BR; adds powerful weapons, mechanics, bosses

breakdown.change: Bosses lurk at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor; defeat to possess suit

breakdown.name: Sprites
breakdown.change: New collectibles with extractable powers; level up collection; Ranked disabled

s.headline: Patch 13.10: Replay bookmarks, Sentinel cooldowns, Gauntlet updates
top_changes: Added personal replay bookmarking feature
Reduced Cypher/Killjoy/Vyse destroy cooldowns to 45s
Updated damage and healing assist rules
Gauntlet: Glitched adds new abilities, glitches, and balance tweaks
Multiple agent and map bug fixes
buffs: Vyse Arc Rose: destroy cooldown 60s to 45s
Sage Healing Orb: improved ally targeting accuracy
Gauntlet Prowler Chonky Cat: health increased
nerfs: Gauntlet Blaze Quickburn: recharge cooldowns increased
Gauntlet Boom Bot Overclocked: speed and duration reduced
Gauntlet Contingency Redundancy: added recharge, fewer charges
Gauntlet Headhunter: added recharge, less ammo
s.meta_impact: Sentinel cooldown reductions encourage more utility placement and resets while rewarding destruction. Assist changes promote trading and reward impactful healing. Gauntlet balance aims to diversify viable upgrades in the mode.

s.headline: Patch 26.23: Pro-prison buffs, ARAM Mayhem & Arena tweaks
top_changes: Buffs to Annie, Azir, Bard, Ezreal, Galio, Gnar, K'Sante, Mel, Vi
Nerfs to LeBlanc, Master Yi, Syndra Q ratios and cooldowns
Voltaic Cyclosword trigger damage reduced
ARAM Mayhem: New headliners, tank augments, turret plating added
Arena balance changes to multiple champions and items
buffs: Annie: Tibbers health, aura damage and AD increased with new HP ratio
Azir: Attack range up to 550, W on-hit ratio to 67%
Bard: Q damage and AP ratio increased
Ezreal: W and R bonus AD/AP ratios buffed
Galio: W shield % max HP increased
Gnar: Q AD ratios increased for mini and mega forms
K'Sante: W mana cost flat, base damage up, charge scaling adjusted
Mel: Q damage and ratios up, W shield and retaliation buffed
nerfs: LeBlanc: Q AP ratio reduced to 35%
Master Yi: Q AD ratio and max single target damage reduced
Syndra: E mana cost to 60, cooldown increased early
Voltaic Cyclosword: Firmament bonus damage lowered to 8%/6%
s.meta_impact: Buffs target pro staples like Azir, Ezreal and Gnar to improve solo queue viability while curbing LeBlanc and Master Yi dominance. ARAM Mayhem gains tank tools and turret defenses to slow games. Arena shifts favor alternative builds like AP Bel'Veth and Tristana.
